title: Code Verification Lab
dek: Patchglass is an RL environment I built in Python for code-repair agents: an agent patches a repository in a container, and its reward comes from running every test on the buggy code and on the patched code. This page rebuilds that grading in your browser on two small tasks.
summary: Four candidate bug fixes: a two-test smoke suite passes three, the full six-test suite passes one. Passing the bug’s own example is not a fix.
